research.searchCoverage: Official Alpha Vantage documentation for apikey query authentication, MARKET_STATUS, GLOBAL_QUOTE, and SYMBOL_SEARCH, US YC S18 identity, and dated incident search (Alpha Vantage + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying Alpha Vantage platform compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware hits are unrelated. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Alpha Vantage query API at www.alphavantage.co
research.searchCoverage: Official Alpha Vantage REST API is GET https://www.alphavantage.co/query with function and apikey query parameters. MARKET_STATUS is the documented global market open/close utility and the pinned credential validator; it is used as healthcheck instead of TIME_SERIES_* or other premium series. GLOBAL_QUOTE and SYMBOL_SEARCH are documented free-tier utilities. Operator is Alpha Vantage Inc. in Boston, Massachusetts (YC S18). HTTP 200 responses may carry Error Message, Information, or Note; native bodyErrorPaths demote those to failures. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Alpha Vantage platform compromise (ALPHV/BlackCat is a distinct ransomware group). Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
